shell.ctaTitle: Get a free building water assessment
shell.ctaSubtitle: See if Beluga is the right fit for your property — no commitment required.
shell.aboutStandardP1: Beluga is a water intelligence platform designed to help buildings better understand their plumbing systems. Using a non-invasive sensor approach, it provides continuous insight into water usage, system behavior, and potential inefficiencies — without requiring modifications to existing infrastructure.
shell.aboutStandardP2: The goal is not only to detect problems, but to make the entire water system more visible, measurable, and manageable over time.
shell.aboutWintP2: The platform is built for building owners, operators, and property managers who want to move beyond reactive leak detection toward proactive water system visibility.
shell.hubCtaTitle: Not sure which system is right for you?
shell.hubCtaSubtitle: Talk to our team for a free building water assessment — no commitment required.
